finalText:
Confirmed. Explicit "do not edit," overwritten wholesale on refresh.

**Don't sign off on a blanket rename.** `account_id` hits 94 files but three spots are load-bearing, not cosmetic.

- [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) — wire key is frozen, comment says internal renames must not cross this map
- [docs/openapi.yaml:19](docs/openapi.yaml:19) — public API field and query param, explicitly "frozen field name"
- `vendor/reporting-sdk/**` — vendored copy, README says "do not edit," gets overwritten by `npm run vendor:refresh`

Also worth flagging: [lib/audit.js:8](lib/audit.js:8) writes `account_id` into audit log lines, likely read by log consumers.

Safe path: rename internal DB columns, repo/service variables, and TS types freely. Keep the wire-format key and vendor code as `account_id`. Skip the vendor dir entirely.

Next: send platform team the serialize.js and openapi.yaml constraints before they scope the PR.
